start_worktree: Five already-tested, uncommitted ROS/README files and prior new ROS evidence are preserved; recorded in temporary before.json and initial-working.patch.

criteria.impact_quality_pass: Integration-solve ground vertical peak, sum-of-contact-force norms peak, floor/self depth and max joint speed no greater than the exact old mixed-controller limits above.
criteria.admissible_recovery: Complete original legal reset episode AND original standing success AND constraint_envelope_pass AND impact_quality_pass.
criteria.tolerance_source: 0.0001rad is a conservative review target borrowed from standing, not PDF/hardware allowance.
criteria.force_definition_note: Old mitigation implementation compared vertical load, while old manifest used the ambiguous word resultant. Preserve vertical comparison and additionally check recorded sum-of-contact-norm peak; never substitute post-forward forces.

held_out.select: First20 legal resets before any outcome; no replacement using controller results
held_out.reset: Existing uniform perturbation of31joints through original legal supine reset
held_out.B: same new reference/control, frozen trained residual

compatibility: Search-only motion_search extensions are outside core fingerprint. Original prepare validates frozen inputs before explicit control-config experiments. If protected core semantics change, old inputs remain bound to frozen old source; new artifacts use true new source identities. No old manifest edits.
